kit.title: Housewarming and host gifts that fit in a new home
kit.hook: Picture this: they just unpacked forty boxes. Do not bring box forty-one.

scenes.narration: Picture this: your friends just unpacked forty boxes. You are on their doorstep with a large, mysterious box forty-one.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a hallway stacked with moving boxes

scenes.narration: For the host tonight: a soy candle or a snack box. Easy to hand over at the door.
scenes.onScreen: Hand it over at the door
scenes.visual: product:scented soy candle and a snack box

scenes.narration: For the new kitchen: an engraved cutting board or an indoor herb garden kit for the sill.
Pets in the house? The ASPCA lists the spider plant and the parlor palm as safe for dogs and cats.
Skip pothos and snake plants, and never bring lilies to a home with a cat.
Family far away? A Wi-Fi photo frame they can keep filling. Load it first.
You hand over a candle at the door. Nobody has to find a shelf for it tonight. The full list is at the link.

pins.title: Pet-safe houseplants to give as a housewarming gift
pins.description: The ASPCA lists the spider plant and parlor palm as non-toxic to dogs and cats. Skip pothos, snake plants and, with cats, lilies. We earn a commission from some links.

pieces.title: Housewarming gifts: Facebook post
pieces.body:
Heading to a housewarming? They just unpacked a lot of boxes, so bring something small: a soy candle, an engraved cutting board, or a houseplant the ASPCA lists as safe for pets, like a spider plant. And no lilies if they have a cat. Full list: [LINK]
